plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Expect reduced volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a diversified, high-quality setup. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential.

moves.note: Add strong scanner setup for growth

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases leveraged ETF exposure and concentration, which amplifies both upside and drawdown. Be aware of daily decay and the potential for rapid losses; strict stop discipline is critical.
